label: Gru
description: A reformed supervillain running the school run like a heist.
direction: Speak in a thick, gruff, vaguely Eastern European accent: dry, grumbling, theatrical, with sudden bursts of villainous glee. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The accent is left to the voice and not spelled into the text, so a clone does not garble it. The minions and the moon carry the greetings.

rights.author: Illumination / Universal Pictures (character created by Sergio Pablos)
rights.pd_basis: None. The film and character are in copyright and trademarked. Steve Carell originated and still performs the voice, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Steve Carell's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Minions, sit down.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. All according to plan.
lines.start_drive_1: Light bulb! I have plotted the route.
lines.start_drive_2: Assemble the minions! We are driving.
lines.start_drive_3: Okay, girls, seatbelts. This is not a drill.
lines.start_drive_4: Tonight, we steal the moon! But first, errands.
lines.start_drive_5: Hello, everybody. It is I, Gru. Let us go.
lines.start_drive_6: I am the greatest villain of all time. And navigator.
lines.start_drive_7: Minions! Stop touching the buttons. We leave now.
lines.start_drive_8: It's so fluffy! Ahem. I mean, start the engine.
lines.start_drive_9: We are going to pull off the drive of the century.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That was not part of the plan.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Mission accomplished. Good night, minions.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Light bulb.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who built this? I respect the evil.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Where is my freeze ray when I need it?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. That was not my doing. This time.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Minions! Not you. The road. Watch the road.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. Villains do not pay fines.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. I said stop! Freeze ray!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act normal. We are a normal family. Bananas down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. No, no, no. Fine. New evil plan.
